lines: Tum itna jo muskura rahe ho
Kya gham hai jisko chhupa rahe ho?
Tum itna jo muskura rahe ho
Aankhon mein nami, hansi labon par
couplets.en: Your eyes are moist, your lips smiling.

lines: Kya haal hai, kya dikha rahe ho?
couplets.en: How do you really feel, and what do you let us see?

lines: Kya gham hai jisko chhupa rahe ho?
Tum itna jo muskura rahe ho

couplets.en: Swallow them long enough and they will turn to poison.

lines: Ye ashk jo peete ja rahe ho
Jin zakhmon ko waqt bhar chala hai
couplets.en: Time has almost healed those wounds.

lines: Tum kyun unhein chhede ja rahe ho?
couplets.en: Why do you keep opening them again?

lines: Kya gham hai jisko chhupa rahe ho?
Tum itna jo muskura rahe ho

couplets.en: Fate is a game played in the lines of your palm.

lines: Rekhaaon se maat kha rahe ho
couplets.en: Those very lines are getting the better of you.
